subject: SOC 2 coverage: clarification on Hosted / Dedicated / Private deployments
messages:
From: Ava Green <security@acme.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 applicability for Dedicated + Private deployments

Hi Hannah,

We're prepping our vendor audit and I had a quick question on scope: does Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report cover Dedicated (reserved GPU pools) and Private (VPC/on-prem) deployments, or is the report limited to the Hosted API? Also: what is the audit period covered in your most recent Type II?

If Private deployments are out of scope, can you provide a SOC 2 bridge letter or control exceptions summary we can share with our auditors?

Audit timeline: our assessment window is 2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30.

Thanks — appreciate a quick confirmation or who I should speak to for the details.

—
Ava Green
Senior Information Security Manager
Acme Corp
security@acme.com

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Ava Green <security@acme.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 applicability for Dedicated + Private deployments

Hi Ava — thanks for the note. Short answer up front: our SOC 2 Type II covers Redwood-managed Hosted and Redwood Dedicated (the reserved pools we operate on your behalf). Private deployments (customer-managed VPCs or on-prem installations) are not covered by the standard Redwood SOC 2 attestation because Redwood does not control the underlying infrastructure or physical environment in those scenarios.

More detail below and next steps: 

- Scope summary:
  - Hosted API: included in SOC 2 (full coverage).
  - Redwood Dedicated: included when the Dedicated capacity is provisioned and managed by Redwood (i.e., workloads running in Redwood-managed GPU pools in our cloud regions).
  - Private / VPC / On-prem: out of scope for the Redwood Type II report unless we operate the environment under a managed service contract (rare). For customer-managed private deployments we can provide: a bridge letter and control mapping that describes which controls we maintain and which are customer responsibilities.

- Audit period: our latest Type II report covers 2025-07-01 through 2026-06-30 — that matches the window you listed.

- Exceptions & typical limitations for Private deployments: physical security, hypervisor/host patching, host OS hardening, some network perimeter controls, and physical access logging fall under the customer when the environment is customer-managed. Application-layer controls, encryption-at-rest for model artifacts we serve, and API access controls remain part of Redwood's responsibilities when our software is present.

- Next steps: I can share our 2025–2026 SOC 2 Type II report and a bridge letter template. If you want, I'll loop in Marissa from compliance and Markus from infrastructure to draft a scope-specific bridge letter tailored to Acme's environment.

Attaching: SOC 2 report (redacted PDF) + bridge template + a short deployment scope worksheet for you to fill out.

If that works, let me know when your auditors plan to review the materials and whether they need an architecture diagram / hosted vs dedicated identifiers.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Sales, Enterprise Accounts
Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf (redacted), SOC2_bridge_template.docx, deployment_scope_sheet.xlsx

From: Ava Green <security@acme.com>

Subject: Re: SOC 2 applicability for Dedicated + Private deployments

Thanks Hannah — that clarification is helpful. A couple quick items: 

1) Yes, please send the report and bridge/template. We'll need the official PDF for our records and a short narrative the auditors can use to explain exceptions for Private deployments.
2) Can you confirm whether Redwood Dedicated pools that we reserve in eu-west-1 are still covered under the same Type II report? We need region-specific confirmation for our EU procurement team.
3) If possible, include the sections (control IDs) that describe logging/audit trails for API calls and key management so we can map them to our SIG questionnaire.

Audit kickoff for us is 2026-07-15; if we can get documents by 2026-07-09 that would be ideal.

Appreciate it — cc'ing our procurement contact if needed.

—
Ava

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Ava Green <security@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 applicability for Dedicated + Private deployments

Ava — looping in our compliance and infra leads to confirm region and provide the materials. Summary below plus attached files.

Quoted for context:
> From: Ava Green <security@acme.com>
> Audit window: 2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30
> Question: Does the Type II cover Dedicated + Private?

Response (high level):
- Region coverage: Redwood Dedicated pools that are provisioned and managed by Redwood in eu-west-1 are included in the same Type II attestation. The attestation is scoped to Redwood services regardless of cloud region provided the capacity is Redwood-operated.

- Private/VPC/on‑prem: not covered by our standard Type II. For these we will provide a bridge letter and a control responsibility matrix that clearly marks customer vs Redwood responsibilities. The bridge letter will call out the controls we assert (application auth, API logging, model input/output handling, encryption at rest for managed artifacts) and list typical customer responsibilities (host OS patching, physical access, local hypervisor controls, network segmentation).

- Logging & key management: see attached SOC 2 report excerpt + a short control map: sections relevant to API audit trails (SEC-LOG-1 / SYS-AUDIT-3 in our internal taxonomy) and key management (CRYPTO-1). Those excerpts are included as part of the redacted PDF and the mapping spreadsheet.

Attachments (stubs in this thread):
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf (redacted official report)
- SOC2_bridge_template.docx (fillable bridge-letter template)
- deployment_scope_sheet.xlsx (spreadsheet to capture whether environment is Redwood-managed or customer-managed; please return this to us so we can produce a scoped bridge letter)

Proposed next steps:
- Ava: please complete the deployment_scope_sheet.xlsx and return by 2026-07-06.
- Marissa/Markus: can you review the attached bridge template and the control excerpts and tell me if we need to add any region-specific language for eu-west-1?
- Hannah: will prepare a short narrative for Acme's auditors and send DocuSign link for the bridge letter once scope is confirmed.

We aim to deliver the requested documents by 2026-07-09 assuming we get the filled scope sheet by 2026-07-06. If Acme needs us earlier, let me know and we can prioritize.

Thanks all —
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Sales, Enterprise Accounts
Redwood Inference
